value.body: A two-year master's degree covering ecology, environmental chemistry, pollution monitoring and control, environmental impact assessment, environmental law and GIS, with lab work, field visits and a project. It leads to consultancy, compliance, NGO, research and teaching roles.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A B.Sc in Environmental Science or a related science (many universities accept any science graduate). Admission is through CUET-PG, a state or university entrance test, or graduation merit.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles are in EIA consultancy, industry EHS teams and pollution-monitoring labs.
Environmental Sciences is a UGC-NET subject, which leads to lectureship or JRF.
It does not by itself make you eligible for the UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination.
